comment: I will truly miss Professor Vendrzyk. She is retiring after Fall 2026, so many of you will never get to know her. She was really helpful in class. Her class involves 30 minutes of lecture and 45 minutes of group work/discussions. Every week there's weekly assignments and for every class there's a tiny bit of homework just to help.

This was possibly the worst class I took at U of R, and it is mostly because of the professor. She gives a short lecture at the beginning of class which is completely unhelpful, and the rest of the class is her giving us the answers to the assignment of the week, which teaches us nothing. This should have been a good and reasonable class, its not.

The class is boring and she can be hard to follow, but she wants her students to get A's and has a lot of mechanisms in her grading to help students achieve that. If u have a ≤ 90% you don't have to take the final and if you do take the final, your final grade is based on the highest average of three different factors. AND she rounds grades. MY G.

If you get a 90% average of higher on her 3 exams your are exempt from the final and automatically get an A in the class. HW is "mandatory" but if you do well on the tests you don't even need to do it. Just study her exam study guide and the in-class work sheets and you will be fine. Very nice lady, her explanations can just be a little confusing.

The best professor in the accounting department! Tons of easy assignments to raise your grade and you can go to her for help with any of them. Class handouts are representative of what you'll see on the exam. Super accessible if you need help with anything. Highly recommend taking her class!! Super nice and cares a lot about her students

Dr. V is one of the most caring and respected professors in the accounting department. Her class is very lecture heavy but she is dedicated and wants everyone to understand the material. If you put in the work and do the homework you will be fine. Dr. V is a great professor and would definitely recommend to visit office hours.

Dr. V is a caring professor and wants everyone to succeed. Her lectures can be long but she makes sure everyone is involved and is very helpful outside of class. Do the assignments and be prepared for class and you will have no problem with this class!

Dr. V is one of the most caring professors at the Robins School. Her lectures can be hard to follow at times but if you dedicate time to the homework and reviewing class notes an A is easily attainable. She is very patient and willing to meet outside of class.
Very approachable and always happy to help when you have any issues. I took two classes from Dr V and I would do many more if I could!

Dr V is not great at explaining things. I think she has trouble articulating herself. The tests are straightforward generally and the homeworks are doable. Overall a fairly easy class, but class time can be rather annoying because you will not learn much until you go and study outside of class.

She is a nice person, but a terrible teacher. It makes you wonder why you are paying so much money when it's more useful to not pay attention and teach yourself the information. She is the reason why tenure should not exist.

unbelievable class. and i mean unbelievably bad. you genuinely cant make some stuff she does up. she loves her poodles, but thats her only redeeming quality. talks in circles. unclear grading criteria. not helpful in office hours. not nice. cannot say enough bad thingabout this class. she should not be allowed to teach -go learn it yourself

be ready to teach yourself. easily worst & most confusing prof i've ever had. genuinely curious to know if she even knows acct, bc her lectures were so confusing we found the class easier to skip & teach ourselves. her grading is unfair because she leaves a lot of REQUIRED directions off the assignments, bc she wants you to "think of it yourself"??

Professor Vendrzyk is the sweetest person and she truly cares about her students. I really enjoyed her class this semester. There are 3 exams and then the final. Final is optional if you average a 90% on the three exams. HW is fair as long as you read the text, and participation in class helps greatly. Take her class if you can!!

Prof Vendrzyk is such a sweet lady and really wants all of her students to be successful. She is very willing and helpful outside of class. Class consists of 3 tests, online homework and formal homework. Final is optional if you have above a 90 test average, and you automatically get an A if you have above a 90 test average.

She's super clear about what's going to be on the tests. She doesn't teach in class but instead goes over what you learn by reading the book at night for homework. Definitely worth it if you're willing to put the time in.

Super easy class but super confusing if you try and learn from her.  I didn't pay attention in class and then taught myself everything the night before exams and did pretty well.  Wouldn't recommend her for accounting majors.
Great teacher. A little awkward in front of class but genuinely nice woman and very friendly. Really wants her students to do well. Very helpful if you email her.

I think prof. vendryzk is a genuinely nice person who is very knowledgeable about the subject. having said that, managerial accounting is one of the most boring subjects in the world. its so difficult to pay attention in class, let alone do the homeworks. it requires a very minimal amount of effort to get a decent grade.
I don't know what everyone else is talking about. She is a very nice teacher but it is very hard to get an A. There is an unbelievable amount of homework.

She is so scatterbrained its hilarious, she says the most random things. The class is pretty easy, and she'll help u with most things. As long as you do the work at put in some effort you should get an A. She lets you work in groups and get help from wherever. It can be frustrating trying to get her to explain something if u don't get it the 1st ti
Really helpful professor. Whenever you have questions, she is always there. Respond to email very quickly. Clear on lectures and homework assignments are extremely helpful.

Really not as great as some make her out to be. You don't have to take the final if you mantain a 90% cum. avg. MAKE SURE you get that A. I missed the margin by .2 points and had to take her stupid final, which was much longer and harder than previous tests. Homework seems endless. Her monotonous voice and dry demeanor will put you to sleep.

Incredibly easy, just do the homework and you will understand the concepts and tests will be a breeze, as all you have to do is study the previous year's test, which she gives you.  You can get an easy A without going to class/paying attention.

Extremely easy.  I had her for managerial and got an A and was exempt from the final exam.  Gives a practice exam before each test and the tests are almost identical, so studying that is all I did to get an A.  Highly recommended for an easy A, not necessarily if you want to learn accounting.
